_readme: Reference template for creating new Sales Estimates in QuickBooks Online, built from estimates 11180, 11172, and 11152.
IMPORTANT: the qbo_sales_create_estimate / qbo_sales_update_estimate tools do NOT expose a custom_fields parameter.

Custom fields (Residential or Commercial, Dealer, RSM, Deposit Due, Q#/Project, Customer PO, etc.) must be set manually in the QBO estimate form after creation, or via a direct QBO API call / n8n workflow that PATCHes the SalesTransaction with a CustomField array.

Looking up an estimate by doc_numbers (e.g. '11180') returns a TRIMMED custom_fields list. Looking it up by its internal estimate_id returns the FULL list. Always use estimate_id when you need every custom field.

customer_project_convention.note: The 'contact.display_name' on the estimate is 'Customer:Project'. The Customer is the parent QBO customer record; the Project is a sub-customer/job under it. When creating a new estimate, resolve the Project's QBO customer_id (not the parent's) via search_customer and pass that as customer_data.customer_id.

examples.display_name: Integrated Door & Window Systems:Patel Entry Door

custom_fields.title: Dealer
custom_fields.note: Large picklist (~90+ dealers, incl. deleted/legacy entries). Pick from the QBO dropdown rather than duplicating the full list here; use 'NO' when there is no dealer.

custom_fields.title: Outside Sales Rep
custom_fields.note: Use 'NO' when there is no outside sales rep involved.

custom_fields.title: Deposit Due
custom_fields.note: Typically ~50% of the estimate total; confirm the company's standard deposit % before filling this in.

custom_fields.title: 2nd RSM
custom_fields.note: Optional; leave blank ('NO') if there is no secondary RSM.

custom_fields.title: Q#/Project
custom_fields.note: Free-text project/quote number. On 11180 this equaled the Customer PO value (95238).

custom_fields.title: Customer PO
custom_fields.note: Customer's own PO/quote reference number. On 11172/11152 this matched the 'Q Number/PO #' field value.

custom_fields.title: JDM Folder
custom_fields.note: Usually blank; internal folder reference when used.

line_item_template.note: Each line needs product_id (from search_products), description, amount (unit rate), quantity, taxable.

example_fields.description: All Aluminum Thermally Broken Panda Select Lift & Slide

custom_field_values.Dealer: Integrated Door and Window Systems, Inc.

new_estimate_checklist: 1. search_customer for the PROJECT name (sub-customer), not the parent company, to get customer_id.
- If the project/sub-customer doesn't exist yet, create it under the parent via QBO UI (or create_customer with the parent as parent, if supported) before creating the estimate.
2. search_products for each item/service line to get product_id and confirm taxable flag.

4. Open the new estimate in QBO and fill in the custom fields listed above (Residential or Commercial, Dealer, RSM, 2nd RSM, Deposit Due, Q#/Project, Customer PO) manually — the MCP create/update tools can't write these.
5. Re-pull the estimate by estimate_id (not doc_number) afterward to verify all custom fields saved correctly.
